zh.title: 发布状态
items: **0.1.0-rc.16** 修复主 Bot 推进中途停下、默认累计执行限制，以及历史中断提示与当前工作状态混淆的问题。正式版仍为 0.0.18，本版用于继续评测。

zh.title: 持续推进与核验
items: 主 Bot 保留未完成工作的责任，调研或进度说明之后继续处理；等待子任务时由后台事件唤醒，常规运行通知不会反复调用模型或生成失败回复。
移除默认累计模型请求、工具调用和核验时长上限。有新进展的工作分段保存原生检查点与结果，随后继续；明确配置的预算、单次调用超时、取消、权限和无进展保护仍然有效。
安全识别旧版本默认限制，在原任务与检查点上继续，保留历史计数和结果。自定义预算与结果未知的操作不会被清零、绕过或重复执行。
独立复核失败属于主 Bot 需要继续处理的技术问题；核对结果、真正交付和等待用户决定分别表达，进度说明不代替验收。

zh.title: 回复、后台任务与历史提示
items: 主 Bot 本次回复失败与子任务仍在执行分别显示。只有同一工作真正送达新的正式回复，才显示回复已恢复。
主动让出调度时保留公开进展和原输入关联；切换、静默等待与重启后不会丢掉已显示的开场白，也不会把内部思考变成聊天内容。
旧中断被接替后折叠为历史记录，迟到的本地错误回执不再重新显示旧的“操作失败”。原始诊断与消息定位继续可用。
显式预算说明实际限制、已用量和来源，区分耗尽、暂时占用及用量未知；只有宿主允许继续时才提供可执行的按钮。

zh.title: 升级与验证范围
items: 升级前备份完整数据根，Desktop、CLI/TUI 与 Gateway 同步升级；回退须恢复完整升级前备份。不要用旧版本重写新的执行策略记录。
源码检查覆盖长任务分段推进、重启、真实本地文件与图片 Provider、HTTP 请求、权限生命周期和恢复状态。模型认知使用受控适配器；不代表真实云模型质量或长时间日用验收。
产品截图由实施者自审，非独立审查。Windows/Linux 交互安装、完整读屏和正式版验收仍需单独完成。

en.title: Release status
items: **0.1.0-rc.16** fixes work stopping after investigation, default cumulative execution limits, and confusion between historical reply interruptions and current work. Stable remains 0.0.18; this prerelease is for continued evaluation.

en.title: Continued execution and verification
items: The main Bot retains responsibility for unfinished work after an investigation or progress update. Background events wake it when child work changes; routine running notifications do not repeatedly call the model or produce failed replies.

Remove default cumulative request, tool-call and verification-duration caps. Productive work saves native checkpoints and results between execution slices, then continues. Explicit budgets, individual-call timeouts, cancellation, permissions and no-progress protection remain enforced.

Safely recognize legacy default limits and continue the original work and checkpoint while retaining usage and results. Custom budgets and unknown operation outcomes cannot be reset, bypassed or replayed.

Failed independent verification remains a technical issue for the main Bot to investigate. Checking results, delivering them and requesting a user decision are separate states; a progress update does not accept work.

en.title: Replies, background tasks and history
items: Show a failed main Bot reply separately from child tasks still running. Only an actually delivered canonical reply for the same work proves recovery.
Preserve public progress and input associations across cooperative yields, quiet waits and restart. Internal reasoning does not become chat content.
Fold superseded interruptions into history, and prevent late local error receipts from reviving old action errors. Original diagnostics and message navigation remain available.
Explicit budget messages show the actual limit, usage and source, distinguishing exhaustion, temporary reservations and unknown usage. Continuation actions appear only when the host allows them.

en.title: Upgrade and validation scope
items: Back up the complete data root and upgrade Desktop, CLI/TUI and Gateway together. Rollback requires the complete pre-upgrade backup; do not let older versions rewrite the new execution-policy records.

Source checks cover long-work slicing, restart, actual local file and image Providers, HTTP requests, permission lifecycles and recovery states. Cognition is controlled; these checks do not establish real cloud model quality or long-term daily use.
Product screenshots receive implementer self-review, not independent review. Interactive Windows/Linux installation, full screen-reader coverage and stable-release acceptance remain separate gates.
